text:
julie: noticed a host parse tail latency spike 11:47-11:50. p50 +18%, p95 +47%. Uploaded traces: s3://rw-debug/4891234567/traces.json

build-bot: Deploy notes: kernel-selector v4.0 applied 11:45, batch-hint tweak applied 11:46, proxy chunk framing v2.0 applied 11:46.

omar: quick look: kv_cache miss-rate increased ~10% in same window. Kernel selector commit lowered the medium->small threshold (commit 1f2d). Could be routing more medium sequences into small kernel which disables batched prefetch.

kevin: traces show many more grpc writev small calls and fragmented chunk headers (host_streamer.cc:line 132). That increases parse syscalls.

ana: repro script: mixed short/medium requests at 80 qps reproduces p95 within ~3m. Use: `hey -n 1000 -c 20 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -D payloads/mix.json https://canary.redwood/api/v1/generate`

julie: plan: (1) rollback kernel-selector on canary, (2) monitor kv_prefetch_hit_rate + grpc_writev_count, (3) if KV improves but grpc stays high, rollback proxy chunk framing.

omar: rolling back kernel-selector now (job 7809).

kevin: added ephemeral counter kv_prefetch_hits to the canary telemetry so we can watch prefetch efficacy live.

build-bot: Job 7809 completed: success.

julie: metrics 5m after rollback: kv miss-rate down 7%, parse p95 down ~22%, grpc small-writes unchanged. Looks like kernel routing was primary cause of KV misses and parse regressions.

omar: follow-up: implement prefetch decoupling so small kernel still issues prefetch for next-M tokens. Also add CI perf test for 30/70 short/medium mix over gRPC.

kevin: opened PR: decouple-prefetch-override and a small e2e perf test. I'll also add a guard in proxy chunker to coalesce tiny headers to avoid small-write storms.

julie: good, once PR merges let's roll a hotfix to stable. Thanks team.
